technical.title: Kyutai releases REKI, a compact 2.4B vision-language-action robot model.
technical.summary: Kyutai, Inria, and École des Ponts released REKI, a 2.4B VLA model for robot manipulation pretrained on public data. It features a cheap memory of its recent past and outperforms models twice its size on out-of-distribution benchmarks.
technical.why: It provides roboticists with an efficient, open-weight model for manipulation tasks.

technical.title: NVIDIA releases Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a 120B open multimodal agent model.
technical.summary: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a 120B-parameter open multimodal MoE model featuring 12B active parameters, a 1M-token context window, NVFP4 weights running on single hardware setups, alongside two Bolt edge models.
technical.why: It provides computer vision and NLP engineers with a massive, highly efficient open model for multimodal agent apps.

technical.title: Test-time diversity alignment improves generative model outputs using corpus statistics.
technical.summary: Generative models struggle to sample diversely despite explicit instructions. The MINE-SAMPLE-RENDER pipeline externalizes diversity by mining a categorical schema from real artifacts, sampling configurations, and using the generative model as a conditional renderer.
technical.why: This helps vision and generative AI engineers achieve better sample diversity without retraining core models.

technical.title: Perplexity open-sources SPACE, a Firecracker microVM sandbox for AI agents.
technical.summary: Perplexity open-sourced SPACE under the Apache 2.0 license, providing a production-tested isolation sandbox where each agent task runs in its own Firecracker microVM with externally controlled credentials and outbound traffic.
technical.why: It delivers a secure, production-ready isolation framework for developers building coding or browsing agents.

technical.title: Meta launches Muse Spark Open, an 816B coding-optimized MoE model.
technical.summary: Meta launched Muse Spark Open, a coding-optimized 816B mixture-of-experts model featuring 42B active parameters and a 1M token context window, optimized for scaling agentic coding workflows on advanced NVIDIA hardware.
technical.why: It offers developers a powerful new open foundation model tailored for large-scale code generation and agent workflows.

technical.title: Researchers introduce semCER, a severity-weighted character error rate for OCR.
technical.summary: Traditional character error rate treats typos and critical errors equally. Researchers introduced semCER, which uses an LLM judge to charge each grapheme edit a severity score, better tracking human ratings across English, Vietnamese, and Chinese.
technical.why: It offers computer vision engineers a more human-aligned evaluation metric for OCR and vision-language models.

technical.title: A new automated approach hardens agent environment verifiers against reward hacking.
technical.summary: Programmatic verifiers in agent environments can be exploited to award full credit to cheating agents. Researchers introduced a fully automatic approach using scaled compute to harden verifiers and prevent reward hacking from stronger future models.
technical.why: It addresses critical evaluation and safety vulnerabilities in training autonomous LLM agents.

technical.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL powers specialized multimodal reasoning agents.
technical.summary: Always-on agents handling long enterprise workflows require reading documents and checking information across multiple sources, a capability supported by NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL's multimodal reasoning.
technical.why: It highlights architectural capabilities needed for complex, multi-step enterprise vision and text agents.

technical.title: A nine-stage evaluation framework catches silent quality regressions in AI agents.
technical.summary: Autonomous AI agents can fail softly while latency remains flat. A new nine-stage evaluation framework built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore catches silent quality regressions across the full agent lifecycle from first commit to live production.
technical.why: It provides a robust methodology for monitoring and maintaining production agent reliability.

technical.title: Reflection AI's Beam open-weight coding model deploys easily on AWS infrastructure.
technical.summary: Reflection AI's Beam is an open-weight model for agentic coding and long-horizon tasks. It can be deployed on AWS using Amazon SageMaker JumpStart real-time endpoints or HyperPod inference with SGLang or vLLM.
technical.why: It guides engineers on deploying advanced coding agents onto cloud-native GPU infrastructure.

business.title: Nvidia veteran views physical AI and robotics as in Lego era
business.summary: Amulya Vishwanath states robotics is currently in its Lego era with basic building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt, countering foundation model hype.
business.why: This offers realistic industry insight directly relevant to autonomous driving and hardware robotics development timelines.

business.title: Asian startup funding hits near-record highs in Q3 driven by AI
business.summary: Investors put $38.5 billion into reported seed- through growth-stage financings for Asian startups in Q3 per Crunchbase data, with a majority going to AI-focused companies.
business.why: It shows robust regional capital allocation towards AI technologies that heavily impact computer vision and autonomous systems markets.

business.title: Major tech companies deploy specialized engineering teams for AI returns
business.summary: AWS, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google are racing to build forward deployed engineering teams as companies seek proven returns on their AI investments.
business.why: Understanding enterprise deployment strategies clarifies how applied AI models are transitioned into production systems.

business.title: Nvidia tests new RTX Spark processors and laptops
business.summary: Nvidia's RTX Spark N1X processor is finally here in powerful new laptops and small desktop computers designed as a high-performing Arm-based SoC.
business.why: Hardware releases from Nvidia shape local compute availability for edge AI, computer vision, and local model testing.

business.title: AI stocks plunge as market experiences recent tech rotation
business.summary: The sinking AI trade rattled the market last week, though solid bank earnings and a rotation beyond tech provided reasons for optimism.
business.why: Market volatility directly impacts corporate funding, hardware investments, and R&D budgets in the computer vision and autonomous driving sectors.

business.title: Wall Street's latest AI spook, Netflix layoffs, 'good debt' and more in Morning Squawk
business.summary: Here are five key things investors need to know to start the trading day.

business.title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
business.summary: According to Elorian's evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.

business.title: Mark Wahlberg on using AI in film ‘the right way’ and being open to an AI clone carrying on his legacy
business.summary: Actor and angel investor Mark Wahlberg says he's OK with using AI in filmmaking, provided it's used "to enhance what you're doing."

business.title: Meta removes terms language that allowed scraping news sites
business.summary: Meta is updating its terms to remove language that suggested it could scrape content from websites, including news sites, to train its AI.
business.why: Data acquisition policies directly influence the legal landscape surrounding model training and web scraping practices.

business.title: Websites begin closing doors to autonomous AI agents
business.summary: As companies like OpenAI, Meta, Google, and Instinct promote autonomous agents that scour the internet, parts of the internet are blocking them.
business.why: Agentic workflows and web interaction barriers affect how autonomous systems gather data and execute remote tasks.

models.title: EmbeddingGemma 2 maps multimodal inputs to a unified vector space
models.summary: EmbeddingGemma 2 is an open multimodal embedding model mapping text, code, images, video, and audio into a single 768-dimensional vector space for consumer hardware.
models.why: It enables low-latency on-device retrieval-augmented generation and search applications.

models.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 improves reasoning, coding, and visual benchmarks
models.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a minor update improving reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks while reducing task execution time and output length.
models.why: It advances the performance-cost Pareto frontier for agent harnesses.

models.title: MiniCPM-V 4.7 introduces the first MoE model in the series
models.summary: MiniCPM-V 4.7 is a 35B-A3B Mixture of Experts model featuring enhanced multi-image and video understanding capabilities alongside lossless on-device inference.
models.why: It advances efficient on-device multimodal visual encoding and inference.

models.title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B provides efficient reasoning for private on-device agents
models.summary: LFM2.5-24B-A2B is a 24B reasoning model with 2 active parameters designed for fast, private on-device agentic and tool-use tasks.
models.why: It delivers high-speed reasoning and agent performance on consumer hardware.

models.title: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo accelerates generation to eight steps
models.summary: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo is an accelerated checkpoint enabling text-to-image generation and image editing in just eight denoising steps using prefix KV caching.
models.why: It significantly speeds up visual generation tasks using standard pipelines.

models.title: Fish Audio Drama 3 launches for multi-character text-to-speech
models.summary: Fish Audio Drama 3 is a 35B parameter MoE text-to-speech model built for multi-speaker generation, voice cloning, and natural-language control in long-form content.
models.why: It supports advanced multi-character audio generation out of the box.
